Package com.nexuslink.protocol.db

Class ExternalDriverLoader

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.db.ExternalDriverLoader
public final class ExternalDriverLoader extends Object
Loads on-demand JDBC drivers from a local jar (or downloads one from Maven Central) and registers them with DriverManager via a DriverShim.

This is what makes the "add Oracle / SQL Server / DB2 when you need it" flow work without bloating the bundled app. See TASKS.md §8.1.1.

    • unload

      public static boolean unload(String driverClass)
      Deregisters a driver loaded by loadFromJar(java.nio.file.Path, java.lang.String) so it stops appearing as available after the user removes it from the driver list. Bundled drivers, which nothing here registered, are left alone.
      Returns:
      true if a shim was deregistered

    • ensureLoaded

      public static boolean ensureLoaded(DriverInfo driver)
      Makes driver usable without any user interaction if its jar is already on this machine — a user driver's own jar, or a jar sitting in DRIVER_DIR (downloaded earlier, or placed there by the user running the mvn command from MavenCommandHelp). Never touches the network.
      Returns:
      true if the driver is available afterwards

    • cachedJar

      public static Optional<Path> cachedJar(String mavenCoords)
      Finds a locally cached jar for group:artifact:version in DRIVER_DIR. Falls back to matching on artifact name alone, so a jar fetched at a slightly different version than the catalog's default is still picked up.

    • downloadAndLoad

      public static void downloadAndLoad(String mavenCoords, String driverClass)
      Downloads a driver jar into DRIVER_DIR and loads it. mavenCoords is group:artifact:version. See MavenRepositoryConfig for how the source repository (Maven Central, or an internal Artifactory/Nexus mirror) is chosen.

    • download

      public static Path download(String mavenCoords) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Resolves the jar for group:artifact:version and returns its cached path, fetching it only if it isn't already on disk. Resolution order:
      1. DRIVER_DIR — previously downloaded by NexusLink
      2. the local Maven repository (~/.m2/repository) — so a machine whose ~/.m2 is already primed needs no network access at all
      3. the configured remote repository (Maven Central or an internal mirror)
      Throws:
      IOException
      InterruptedException
